transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I keep noticing this small uneven spot around my nose and cheek. It shows up more in photos or under the lights at work, and… even when people say they don’t see it, I feel like it’s what customers or my managers notice first.
Is it just your nose and cheek that you're concerned about, or are there other parts of your body that you worry about as well?

Mostly that area… the nose and cheek. It’s this tiny uneven spot that I keep getting stuck on, especially in photos or under the store lights. I know people say they don’t really see it, but it feels like it’s the first thing customers or my managers notice.
How much distress does this uneven spot cause you on a daily basis?

It’s… not like I can’t function, but it bothers me most days. I get stuck thinking about that spot around my nose and cheek, especially at work under the lights, and I worry people notice it right away.
Is your concern about the uneven spot around your nose and cheek related to how it affects your overall appearance?

Yeah… I think so. It’s mostly that I feel like it makes my face look off, especially in photos or under the store lights. Even if people say they don’t notice, I kind of feel like it’s the first thing they see.
Do you think you would feel better about your appearance if this uneven spot were gone?

Yeah… I think I would. If it wasn’t there, I feel like I wouldn’t get so stuck on it in photos or under the store lights. It just feels like it’s what people notice first, even when they say they don’t.
Is your concern about your appearance limited to this one uneven spot, or do you also worry about other aspects of how you look?

Mostly just that one spot… the uneven area around my nose and cheek. I notice it a lot in photos or under the store lights, and it feels like customers or managers see it right away, even if they say they don’t.
Do you think your concern about the uneven spot is in line with how much it actually affects your appearance to others?
Probably not… I mean, people say they don’t really see it. But to me it feels really obvious, especially in photos or under the store lights. Like customers or managers would notice it right away.
Is your concern only about how this uneven spot looks, or is it also about what it might mean about you as a person?

Mostly how it looks, I think. I just get stuck on that little uneven spot by my nose and cheek… like in photos or under the store lights. Even when people say they don’t see it, it feels like customers or managers notice it first.
Is your concern about the uneven spot around your nose and cheek the only thing that bothers you about your appearance, or are there other specific flaws you worry about?

It’s really just that spot, I think… around my nose and cheek. I get stuck on it in photos or under the store lights, like it’s the first thing customers or managers would see, even when people tell me they don’t notice it.
Do you think you would be ugly if this uneven spot was not fixed?

I don’t know if I’d say ugly exactly… it’s more that I keep focusing on that uneven spot by my nose and cheek. In photos or under the store lights, it just feels like that’s what people notice first, even if they say they don’t.
Is your concern about your appearance focused only on this one uneven spot around your nose and cheek?

Yeah… it’s basically that one spot. The tiny uneven area around my nose and cheek. I keep noticing it in pictures and under the store lights, and it feels like customers or managers see it right away, even if other people say they don’t.
Do you worry that this uneven spot will affect how people perceive you as a person?

Yeah… I guess I do. Like, I worry they’ll see that spot first and think something about me, especially customers or managers under the store lights. Even when people say they don’t notice it, I still get stuck on it.
Do you think your life would change in any significant way if you didn't have this concern about the uneven spot?

Yeah… probably. I think I’d be faster at work, at least. My manager’s noticed I come back from breaks late sometimes and that I’m slower at the register. I worry it makes me look unreliable, especially since I’m trying to get promoted.
Is your worry about the uneven spot more about the spot itself or what having it might mean about your character or abilities?

I think it’s more about the spot itself… like I just get stuck seeing that tiny uneven area around my nose and cheek. In photos or under the store lights, it feels like that’s the first thing people notice, even when they say they don’t.
Do you think that your belief about the uneven spot being the first thing people notice is definitely true, no matter what others say?

I don’t know if I’d say definitely true… but it feels true in the moment. Like, even if someone says they don’t see it, I still keep thinking that tiny uneven spot by my nose and cheek is what they notice first, especially in photos or under the store lights.
Do you think your belief about the uneven spot being the first thing people notice might be wrong, even if it feels true to you?

Maybe… yeah. I mean, I know people say they don’t see it, so I guess it could be wrong. It just doesn’t feel that way when I’m under the store lights or looking at photos. I get stuck on that tiny uneven spot around my nose and cheek, and it feels like it’s the first thing customers or my managers notice.
Do you think there's anything that could change your mind about how noticeable the uneven spot is to others?

Maybe if I could really see that other people don’t notice it… I don’t know. People tell me they don’t, but when I’m in photos or under the store lights, I just get stuck on that little uneven spot by my nose and cheek. It still feels like customers or managers see it first.
Do you think you would still worry about your appearance if the uneven spot around your nose and cheek were completely gone?

I’m not sure. I mean… that’s the thing I keep getting stuck on right now. In photos or under the store lights, it just feels like that spot is what people notice first, even when they say they don’t see it.
If the uneven spot around your nose and cheek were completely gone, do you think you would then worry about a different part of your appearance?

Maybe. I don’t really know. Right now it’s just… that spot by my nose and cheek. That’s what I keep getting stuck on, especially in photos or under the store lights. It feels like that’s what people see first.
